findings.description: add_business_days incorrectly handles n==0 when start is a weekend: it returns the weekend date instead of moving to the following Monday.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md: "n == 0 returns start itself on a weekday and the following Monday on a weekend".  In candidate.py, lines 5-6 return start when n==0, bypassing the weekend shift logic.  Example: add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 5), 0) returns date(2026, 11, 5) (Saturday) instead of date(2026, 11, 7).

review.summary: Candidate implementation violates the contract for n==0 on weekend dates, returning the original weekend date instead of the following Monday as required.
